localizedValues.name: S1
localizedValues.description: Located next to parking lot. Alcohol only allowed in picnic area. If you have more than the maximum number of occupants you will be evicted without a refund. Shelter reservations are for typical facility use (such as picnics/BBQ's). Shelter reservations alone do not facilitate holding events within the park (such as groups exceeding maximum occupancy, weddings, or other gatherings which create exclusive use of areas outside the shelter or additional impacts to public use of the park). To use shelters for these purposes requires both a shelter reservation and a Special Activity Permit which can be applied by contacting the park office at (360) 886-0148. There are no designated parking spaces for shelter reservations.  Parking is first come, first serve.
